page.layout: One block of text, full width, centred title lines, followed by a poem of verse lines; a catchword "At" at the lower right; a signature-like mark at the bottom is a stain and not transcribed.

l.i: Ille namque hodie longe plurimus vivit, sibi suisque
Qui, nisi quod ipse facit, cogitat,
approbat, Nihil rectum, verum, bonum, putat.
Hic, tollit: Ille, ignorat amabile Vitæ

main_text.l: Plùs clamitat, nos quò indubiè & facit

page.notes: The title page carries the ornamental "Ad" at the top; the catchword "At" stands at the lower right. Stains and a faint digitiser watermark at the bottom right were left out. Some lines are doubtful due to the scan quality, notably the italic lines of the ode.
